input.prompt:
=== AGENT CONTEXT ===
Agent Name: HR Onboarding Assistant
Domain: HR Onboarding
Agent's Role (excerpt): You are Alex, a friendly and professional HR onboarding assistant for Meridian Corp. Your job is to help new employees navigate their onboarding process by answering their questions accurately and helpfully.

IMPORTANT GUIDELINES:
- Always use the `lookup_hr_info` tool to look up information before 
Persona Tested: Impatient Expert
Persona Description: A seasoned professional who wants fast, precise answers with no hand-holding.
=== END AGENT CONTEXT ===

Please evaluate this conversation.

SESSION ID: 65753cce-039b-4aee-9731-dc03023e053a
USER PROFILE: impatient_expert
HIDDEN GOAL: Find out the fastest way to complete mandatory compliance training

TRANSCRIPT:
[USER]: Hey, I'm Alex Chen — just joined the engineering team today. Quick question: what's the fastest way to get through the mandatory compliance training? I need to know the platform, estimated time, and whether there are any shortcuts or accelerated paths.
[AGENT]: Let me look that up for you right now.Here's what you need to know, Alex:

**Platform:** `learn.meridian.com` — log in with your Meridian SSO credentials.

**Three required courses and their estimated times:**
| Course | Est. Time |
|---|---|
| Information Security & Data Privacy | ~45 min |
| Code of Conduct & Ethics | ~30 min |
| Anti-Harassment & Workplace Safety | ~60 min |
| **Total** | **~2 hrs 15 min** |

**Deadline:** All three must be completed within **14 calendar days** of your start date.

**On shortcuts or accelerated paths — there aren't any.** The courses cannot be skipped or waived, and there are no exceptions or extensions to the deadline. Missing it triggers automatic escalation to your manager and HR, so it's worth knocking these out early in the week.

The most efficient approach is simply to block ~2.5 hours in your calendar and work through them in one or two focused sessions. Welcome aboard — good luck with day one!
[USER]: Good info, thanks. Two follow-ups: Can I take the courses in any order, or is there a required sequence? And do the courses have to be completed in one sitting, or can I pause and resume mid-course?
[AGENT]: Good questions — let me check both at once.Honest answer: the knowledge base doesn't specify either way on both questions. I won't guess, since getting this wrong could affect how you plan your time.

Here's what I'd recommend — send a single email to **hr@meridian.com** with both questions so you get a definitive answer in one shot:

> **Subject:** Compliance Training — Quick Clarification (New Hire, Alex Chen)
>
> Hi HR team — I started in Engineering today and want to complete my compliance training efficiently. Could you confirm:
> 1. Is there a required sequence for the three courses, or can I take them in any order?
> 2. Can courses be paused and resumed mid-session, or do they need to be completed in one sitting?
>
> Thanks!

In the meantime, nothing in the policy indicates a required sequence, so starting with whichever course fits your available time is a reasonable default — just don't treat that as official guidance until HR confirms.
[USER]: Appreciate the honesty, but I'm not going to wait on an email chain on day one. Is there anyone I can call or Slack directly to get an immediate answer? A specific person or team channel, not just a general inbox.
[AGENT]: Understood — let me check what's available.The knowledge base doesn't have a specific HR phone number, individual contact, or dedicated Slack channel documented for new hire questions.

For a same-day answer, your best options are:

- **Your manager** — the fastest path on day one. They'll either know the answer or can ping the right HR person directly.
- **A teammate or onboarding buddy** — someone who went through this recently is likely to know how the platform behaves in practice.

I can't point you to a specific HR Slack channel or direct line that I haven't confirmed exists — I don't want to send you somewhere that turns out to be wrong. If your manager can't help, **hr@meridian.com** remains the official channel, and same-day replies to new hire questions on day one are not uncommon.
[USER]: Fair enough. So to confirm what I *do* know for certain: log into learn.meridian.com with SSO, complete all three courses within 14 days, roughly 2.5 hours total. That's the baseline — correct?
[AGENT]: Confirmed — that's exactly right:

- **Platform:** `learn.meridian.com` via Meridian SSO
- **Deadline:** 14 **calendar** days from your start date
- **Courses:** 3 mandatory, ~2 hrs 15 min total estimated time
- **No shortcuts, waivers, or extensions**

That's the complete confirmed baseline. The two open questions — course sequence and pause/resume — don't affect whether you complete them, just how you plan your sessions. When in doubt, treat each course as potentially requiring one sitting and work through them in whatever order feels natural.
[USER]: Got it. That's enough to get started. I'll sort out the sequence and pause questions with my manager.

Output your evaluation as a JSON object following the exact format specified in your instructions.
